items.title: John Pope Interview, 1959-05-01
items.q: And he knows this man. He knows you, too.

ctx.x: Yes, indeed. This male man I met, his name is Thomas Daley. Thomas Daley? Thomas Daley Senior. And he knows this man. He knows you, too. You mentioned this other man was about your age, he thought, or maybe even older.

That's right. He may be a year older than I have. That's Bolero, we have reference. Yes. So we'll get to see. Well, Daley, back in the middle, I think you might have met some of the younger... Probably.
He was a younger man. He was a male man.
